mapper.select: /*commonPopupMprq.quotationReDetailPopHd*/ SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS COM_NAME_LOC , MAX(A.BTOA_USER_NAME) AS BTOA_USER_NAME , MAX(A.BTOA_DATE) AS BTOA_DATE , MAX(A.BTOA_USER_TEL) AS BTOA_USER_TEL , MAX(A.BTOA_USER_MAIL) AS BTOA_USER_MAIL , MAX(A.QUOTATION_NO) AS QUOTATION_NO , MAX(A.REF_NO) AS REF_NO , MAX(A.BTOA_USER_DEPT) AS BTOA_USER_DEPT FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO = #{st_quotation_no} AND A.REVISION = #{st_revision} AND A.STATUS <> 'D'

/*commonPopupMprq.quotationReDetailPopDt*/ SELECT X.REVISION, X.BUYER_ITEM_NO, X.DESCRIPTION, X.ITEM_QTY, X.MAKER_NAME, X.AGENT, X.GR_FLAG, X.CONFIRM_USER_ID, X.BTOA_REMARK, X.IMAGE_KEY, X.QUOTATION_SEQ, X.SOURCING_STATUS, X.SPECIFICATION, X.UNIT_MEASURE, X.ORIGIN_NAME, X.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, X.PO_FLAG, X.CANCEL_REMARK, X.ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE, X.ITEM_TYPE, X.BTOA_AGENT_NAME, X.SG_ID, X.SG_NAME, (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = X.SG_MNG_ID) AS SG_MNG_NM, ( SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, '', COUNT(*)) FROM BNTNEGOHISTORY H WHERE H.BUYER=X.BUYER AND H.QUOTATION_NO=X.QUOTATION_NO AND H.QUOTATION_SEQ=X.QUOTATION_SEQ AND H.REVISION=X.REVISION ) AS NEGO_COUNT, X.CANCEL_USER_NAME FROM ( SELECT MAX(A.REVISION) AS REVISION , MAX(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , MAX(A.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION , MAX(A.ITEM_QTY) AS ITEM_QTY , MAX(A.MAKER_NAME) AS MAKER_NAME , MAX(A.AGENT_NAME) AS AGENT , '' AS GR_FLAG , MAX((SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.CONFIRM_USER_ID)) AS CONFIRM_USER_ID , MAX(A.BTOA_REMARK) AS BTOA_REMARK , MAX(A.IMAGE_KEY) AS IMAGE_KEY , MAX(A.QUOTATION_SEQ) AS QUOTATION_SEQ , CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='GD' THEN '견적취소' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='CC' THEN '장바구니' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG) = 'GS' THEN '결재진행중' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG) = 'GR' THEN '결재반려' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='PM' THEN '내부품의및카탈로그등록중' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='CM' THEN '합의완료' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.KEP_USER_ID) IS NULL THEN '고객사견적의뢰' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(B.AGENT_REVISION)=1 AND MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='N' AND MAX(B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG)<>'Y' THEN '협력사견적요청' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(B.AGENT_REVISION)<>1 AND MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='N' THEN '협력사재견적요청' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='N' AND MAX(B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG)='Y' THEN '협력사선정완료' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='Y' THEN '고객사견적제시' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='Y' THEN '고객사NEGO의뢰' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='Y' THEN '고객사NEGO견적제출' END END END END END END END END END END END END END AS SOURCING_STATUS , MAX(A.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION , MAX(A.UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE , MAX((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE=A.ORIGIN_CODE)) AS ORIGIN_NAME , MAX(A.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE) BUYER_TARGET_PRICE , '' AS PO_FLAG , MAX(A.CANCEL_REMARK) AS CANCEL_REMARK , MAX(A.ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE) ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE , DECODE(MAX(A.ITEM_TYPE),'O','1회성','T','계약','N','일반') AS ITEM_TYPE , MAX(A.BUYER) AS BUYER , MAX(A.QUOTATION_NO) AS QUOTATION_NO , MAX(A.BTOA_AGENT_NAME) AS BTOA_AGENT_NAME , MAX(A.SG_ID) AS SG_ID , NVL(MAX(SG.SG_NAME),' ') AS SG_NAME , MAX((SELECT MAX(TEXT1) FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE ='CMDSM' AND COD.CODE1 = A.SG_ID AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD.TEXT2 = 'Y')) AS SG_MNG_ID , MAX((SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.CANCEL_USER_ID)) AS CANCEL_USER_NAME FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B, KEPSGMG SG WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO = #{st_quotation_no} AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER(+) AND A.QUOTATION_NO=B.QUOTATION_NO(+) AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=B.QUOTATION_SEQ(+) AND A.REVISION=B.REVISION(+) AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND B.STATUS(+) <> 'O' AND A.SG_ID = SG.SG_ID(+) GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION ) X

/*commonPopupMprq.newSourcingBuyerList*/ SELECT A.BUYER AS BUYER, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM KEPRQDT A , (SELECT BUYER FROM BUYEROWN WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID} ) M WHERE A.BUYER = M.BUYER AND A.BTOA_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -3), 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('NW', 'GA') AND A.SO_CA_FLAG='SO' AND A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE=0 AND A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE=0 AND A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG='N' AND A.KEP_USER_ID IS NULL AND (A.STATUS = 'C' OR A.STATUS = 'R') AND A.BUYER IN ( SELECT A.BUYER FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3 WHERE COD3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD3.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD3.CODE1= 'ALL' AND COD3.CODE2 = #{USER_ID} UNION ALL SELECT MNG.BUYER FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3, MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE COD3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD3.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD3.CODE1= MNG.KEP_DEPT AND COD3.CODE2 = #{USER_ID} AND MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' UNION ALL SELECT BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C' AND KEP_USER_ID = #{USER_ID} UNION ALL SELECT COD.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD , ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE COD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD.CODE1 = CMPY.COM_CODE AND COD.CODE2 = #{USER_ID} AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TEXT2 AND TEXT3 ) GROUP BY A.BUYER
SELECT /*selectBidSucessCodePop*/ CODE , TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M106' AND CODE NOT IN ('BS01','BS09') AND FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY VALUE1
SELECT /*selectMarginReSelectPop*/ CODE , TEXT1 , TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M107' ORDER BY VALUE1

SELECT /*selectSellerChoice4Pop*/ MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=B.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME , B.AGENT AS AGENT , COUNT(B.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS ITEM_CNT , SUM(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE) AS TOT_AMT FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG='N' AND A.RECV_FLAG='GA' AND B.BUYER=A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION=A.REVISION AND B.SEL_USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.STOA_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') GROUP BY B.BUYER, B.QUOTATION_NO, B.REVISION, B.AGENT

SELECT /*selectSellerChoice4CntPop*/ COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT , MAX( (SELECT MAX(ROWNUM) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM KEPRQDT RQDT, KEPQTDT QTDT WHERE RQDT.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND RQDT.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND RQDT.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND RQDT.ATOB_SEND_FLAG='N' AND QTDT.BUYER=RQDT.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO=RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ=RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION=RQDT.REVISION AND QTDT.SEL_USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND QTDT.STOA_DATE IS NOT NULL AND QTDT.STATUS IN ('C','R') GROUP BY RQDT.BUYER, RQDT.QUOTATION_NO, RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ, RQDT.REVISION ) X ) ) AS ITEM_CNT FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO = #{st_quotation_no} AND A.REVISION = #{st_revision} AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND A.RECV_FLAG='GA'

SELECT /*selectPumPrintPop*/ Y.BUYER, Y.QUOTATION_NO, Y.QUOTATION_SEQ, Y.REVISION FROM KEPRQDT Y WHERE Y.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND Y.QUOTATION_NO = #{st_quotation_no} AND Y.REVISION = #{st_revision} AND Y.RECV_FLAG NOT IN('GD','PM') AND Y.STATUS IN ('C','R') ORDER BY Y.QUOTATION_NO, Y.QUOTATION_SEQ

SELECT /*selectQuotationInitListPop*/ BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION, AGENT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, AGENT_REVISION, REVISION_R, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, LEAD_TIME, ATOS_DATE, ATOS_END_DATE, ATOS_END_TIME, SEL_USER_ID, SEL_USER_NAME, SEL_USER_TEL, STOA_LIST_PRICE, STOA_DATE, STOA_TIME, ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, ATOS_TARGET_PRICE, ITEM_QTY, STOA_REMARK, IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(IMAGE_KEY, '',0,1) AS IMAGE_KEY_IMG, BID_SUCCESS_FLAG, SELLER_IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(SELLER_IMAGE_KEY,'',0,1) AS SELLER_IMAGE_KEY_IMG, BID_SUCCESS_CODE, DSS_FLAG, DSS_CHOICE, ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG, ATOB_SEND_FLAG, ATOB_DATE, ATOB_TIME, BTOA_NEGO_PRICE, BID_SUCCESS_REASON FROM KEPQTDT_R WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND QUOTATION_NO = #{st_quotation_no} AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #{st_quotation_seq}

SELECT /*selectSellerUnitPriceHistoryPop*/ ROWNUM AS NO, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, BUYER_ITEM_NO, STOA_DATE, STOA_LIST_PRICE, STOA_REMARK, AGENT_REVISION FROM KEPQTDT WHERE BUYER= #{st_buyer} AND QUOTATION_NO= #{st_quotation_no} AND QUOTATION_SEQ= #{st_quotation_seq} AND REVISION= #{st_revision} AND AGENT= #{st_agent} AND STATUS <> 'D'

SELECT /*selectNegoviewPop*/ A.REVISION, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.ATOB_DATE, A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, A.REJECT_REMARK, A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE, A.BTOA_END_DATE FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND A.RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND A.STATUS <> 'D'

/* selectMasterMpRqSgChoicePop */ SELECT SG_ID , SG_NAME FROM KEPSGMG WHERE STATUS != 'D'
AND SG_ID LIKE UPPER('%' || #{st_sg_id} || '%')
AND SG_NAME LIKE ('%' || #{st_sg_nm} || '%')
ORDER BY SG_ID

SELECT /*selectSamyangNegoviewPop*/ A.NEGO_SEQ, A.REVISION, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.NEGO_PRICE, TO_CHAR(A.NEGO_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS NEGO_DATE, A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE, A.BTOA_NEGO_REMARK, A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE FROM BNTNEGOHISTORY A WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} UNION ALL SELECT '1' AS NEGO_SEQ, B.REVISION, B.QUOTATION_NO, B.QUOTATION_SEQ, B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS NEGO_PRICE, B.ATOB_DATE AS NEGO_DATE, B.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE, B.REJECT_REMARK AS BTOA_NEGO_REMARK, B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE FROM KEPRQDT B WHERE B.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND B.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND B.REVISION= #{st_revision} AND B.RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND (select count(*) FROM BNTNEGOHISTORY A WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} ) < 1 ORDER BY NEGO_SEQ DESC

'재견적요청') AS SOURCING_STATUS, CASE WHEN A.RECV_FLAG ='GD' THEN '견적취소' ELSE CASE WHEN B.STATUS='O' AND A.STATUS='O' THEN '차수증가종료' ELSE CASE WHEN B.STOA_LIST_PRICE = 0 AND B.STOA_REMARK IS NOT NULL THEN '견적포기' ELSE CASE WHEN NVL(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE, 0)=0 AND B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MMSS') THEN '견적미제출' ELSE CASE WHEN NVL(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE, 0)=0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPQTDT QT WHERE QT.BUYER=B.BUYER AND QT.QUOTATION_NO=B.QUOTATION_NO AND QT.QUOTATION_SEQ=B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QT.REVISION=B.REVISION AND QT.STATUS <> 'D' AND QT.AGENT=B.AGENT)=1 AND B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MMSS') THEN '신규견적요청' ELSE CASE WHEN NVL(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE, 0)=0 THEN '재견적요청' ELSE CASE WHEN B.STOA_LIST_PRICE<>0 AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('GA', 'GS','GR', 'PM') THEN '견적제출' ELSE CASE WHEN B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG='Y' THEN '단가선정' ELSE CASE WHEN B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG='N' THEN '단가미선정' END END END END END END END END END AS AGENT_SOURCING_STATUS, B.ATOS_DATE, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, B.SELLER_ITEM_NO, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.MAKER_NAME, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' and code=A.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME, A.ITEM_QTY, A.KEP_USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID AND STATUS <> 'D') AS KEP_USER_NAME, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, B.ATOS_END_DATE, B.ATOS_END_TIME, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, NVL(TRIM(A.ATOS_REMARK),'') AS ATOS_REMARK, DECODE(A.IMAGE_PASS_FLAG,'Y',A.IMAGE_KEY,A.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY) AS IMAGE_KEY, A.BUYER, A.REVISION, B.AGENT, B.AGENT_REVISION, A.REMARK_URL, B.ORIGIN_NAME AS ORIGIN_CODE, B.LEAD_TIME, B.STOA_LIST_PRICE, NVL(B.ORG_STOA_LIST_PRICE, B.STOA_LIST_PRICE) AS ORG_STOA_LIST_PRICE, B.ITEM_QTY * NVL(B.ORG_STOA_LIST_PRICE, B.STOA_LIST_PRICE) AS ITEM_AMT, B.STOA_REMARK, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(A.BUYER, '01') AND STATUS <> 'D') AS BUYER_NAME, A.REF_NO, A.CMS_CATEG_ID, A.CMS_CATLG_ID, (SELECT SPECIFICATION FROM CMSCATLG WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = A.CMS_CATLG_ID) AS CMS_SPEC, B.STOA_DATE, B.STOA_TIME, A.MAKER_PART_NO, A.MSDS_YN, B.MIN_ORDER_QTY, B.PUR_UNIT_QTY, B.SELLER_AREA, NVL(A.RFQ_IMG_FLAG,'N') AS RFQ_IMG_FLAG, B.PRE_GR_FLAG, A.PLANT, F_GET_BUYER_PLANT_TEXT(A.BUYER, A.PLANT) AS PLANT_NAME, A.SAFETY_FLAG, B.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY, B.IMGFILE_DIR, B.IMGFILE_NAME, NVL(C.VAT_FLAG,'N') AS VAT_FLAG, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE='TX17' AND COD.CODE = B.TAX_TYPE) AS TAX_TYPE, (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE='TX17' AND COD.CODE = B.TAX_TYPE) AS TAX_TYPE_CODE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M132' AND CODE = B.ITEM_MAKE_TYPE) AS ITEM_MAKE_TYPE, (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M132' AND CODE = B.ITEM_MAKE_TYPE) AS ITEM_MAKE_TYPE_CODE, B.PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'M034' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD.CODE = B.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_NM, A.BTOA_USER_ID, CASE WHEN NVL(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE, 0) > 0 THEN CASE WHEN B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MMSS') THEN CASE WHEN B.ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' THEN CASE WHEN A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'N' THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPQTDT WHERE 1=1 AND BUYER = B.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = B.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION = B.REVISION AND AGENT_REVISION = B.AGENT_REVISION AND STATUS = 'C' AND BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y') = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ELSE 'N' END ELSE 'N' END ELSE 'N' END ELSE 'N' END AS MODIFY_FLAG FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B, KEP_BUYER_FLAG C WHERE A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.QUOTATION_NO=B.QUOTATION_NO AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND A.QUOTATION_NO = #{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = #{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION = #{st_revision} AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.REVISION=B.REVISION AND A.BUYER = C.COM_CODE(+) AND B.AGENT=#{st_agent} AND B.AGENT_REVISION = #{st_agent_revision} AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') )X )Y )Z
